fusions.name: Ledge Shove
fusions.desc: A head-butt that deals 14 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bunny Kicks
fusions.desc: Kicks out in every direction, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Cliffside Stance
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds and your dodge chance by 8% while it lasts.

fusions.name: Always Upright
fusions.desc: When you take non-fire damage, you gain a ward that absorbs 15% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
